mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 2% year-over-year, it signals a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases below 4%, it signals a tightening labor market with potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage inflation
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE < 4% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) above $500 billion signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS > $500 billion and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a potential supply crunch and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% and FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
